h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Latur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Latur

items.pText: Latur has built a reputation in Maharashtra for its schools and coaching classes, and education is where most of our enquiries from the city come from. A school playground in Latur has to serve many children in short breaks, on dry ground that bakes hard in summer. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 400 km away, and sends it to Marathwada by road.

Being in the same state helps with planning and dispatch. Closer to home, we installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. For your school, share the ground size, the number of children per break and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Our team or a dealer installs everything once you approve.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Designing for short, crowded school breaks

c: When several classes come out together, children crowd the first piece they reach. Spread the equipment so that the busiest items, usually slides and swings, are at opposite ends of the ground. A multi play system with several slides and climbing routes, such as one from our
range, lets many children play at once without queues.

Marathwada's black soil turns hard and cracked in the dry months, then soft after heavy rain. Grouting each post in concrete keeps the equipment stable through both. Lay rubber flooring under the busiest pieces, read about our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What equipment suits a large school in Latur?
items.a: A multi play system with several slides and climbing routes, plus swings and see-saws placed apart from it. This spreads children out during breaks and reduces queues.

items.q: Do you install in Latur from your Vasai factory?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Maharashtra. On hard Marathwada soil we usually recommend grouting.

items.q: What details should a school send for a quote?
items.a: The length and width of the ground, the age range, roughly how many children play at once, and a few photos. We use these to prepare a layout drawing and quote.
